race.title: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NO BOUNDARIES has way more potential than most in this and with his yard amongst the winners, Jane Williams' 4-y-o gets the nod to build on his promising return. For Old Times Sake should be all the sharper for his return so he can be the one to provide most resistance, with recent-winner Wispit Twob completing the shortlist with Bowen retaining the partnership. NO BOUNDARIES (FR) FOR OLD TIMES SAKE (IRE) WISPIT TWOB (IRE)
